name: servotab
description: A quiet, risk-scaled engineering method layer for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Servotab helps Codex plan, change, debug, review, and verify code, scripts, configuration, hooks, automation, and services, inside or outside a repository. Clear changes stay direct. Risk and uncertainty determine method depth, and fresh evidence verifies the complete requested outcome.
defaultPrompt: Use $servotab to find why this local startup hook fails, fix the cause, and verify the repair.
Use $review to inspect this diff and report only verified, actionable correctness and regression findings.
Use $spec-chain to turn this approved specification into a complete implementation plan without shrinking its scope.
